statusLine.command:
input=$(cat)
field() { printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r "$1 // empty"; }
level_color() { if [ "$1" -ge 80 ]; then echo 31; elif [ "$1" -ge 50 ]; then echo 33; else echo 32; fi; }
cwd=$(field '.workspace.current_dir')
dir=$(printf '%s' "$cwd" | sed "s|^$HOME|~|")
git_paths=$(git -C "$cwd" --no-optional-locks rev-parse --path-format=absolute --show-toplevel --git-dir --git-common-dir 2>/dev/null)
if [ -n "$git_paths" ]; then
  top=$(printf '%s\n' "$git_paths" | sed -n 1p)
  gitdir=$(printf '%s\n' "$git_paths" | sed -n 2p)
  common=$(printf '%s\n' "$git_paths" | sed -n 3p)
  if [ "$gitdir" != "$common" ]; then
    dir="$(dirname "$common" | sed "s|^$HOME|~|") ⎇ $(basename "$top")${cwd#"$top"}"
  fi
fi
branch=$(git -C "$cwd" --no-optional-locks symbolic-ref --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || git -C "$cwd" --no-optional-locks rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null)
printf '\033[36m%s\033[0m' "$dir"
if [ -n "$branch" ]; then printf '\033[33m (%s)\033[0m' "$branch"; fi
model=$(field '.model.display_name')
effort=$(field '.effort.level')
if [ -n "$model" ]; then printf '  \033[35m%s\033[0m' "$model"; fi
if [ -n "$effort" ]; then printf '\033[90m · %s\033[0m' "$effort"; fi
cost=$(field '.cost.total_cost_usd')
pct=$(field '.context_window.used_percentage')
five=$(field '.rate_limits.five_hour.used_percentage')
seven=$(field '.rate_limits.seven_day.used_percentage')
if [ -n "$cost$pct$five$seven" ]; then printf '\n'; fi
if [ -n "$cost" ]; then printf '$%.2f  ' "$cost"; fi
if [ -n "$pct" ]; then
  p=$(printf '%.0f' "$pct")
  if [ "$p" -gt 100 ]; then p=100; fi
  if [ "$p" -lt 0 ]; then p=0; fi
  filled=$(( (p + 5) / 10 ))
  c=$(level_color "$p")
  printf '\033[%sm' "$c"
  i=0
  while [ $i -lt 10 ]; do
    if [ $i -eq $filled ]; then printf '\033[90m'; fi
    if [ $i -lt $filled ]; then printf '\342\226\210'; else printf '\342\226\221'; fi
    i=$((i + 1))
  done
  printf '\033[%sm %s%%\033[0m' "$c" "$p"
  tokens=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '[.context_window.total_input_tokens, .context_window.context_window_size] | select(all(type == "number")) | map(if . >= 999950 then "\(. / 1e5 | round / 10)M" elif . >= 1000 then "\(. / 1e2 | round / 10)k" else tostring end | sub("(?<n>^[0-9]+)(?<s>[kM])$"; "\(.n).0\(.s)")) | join("/")')
  if [ -n "$tokens" ]; then printf ' (%s)' "$tokens"; fi
  printf '  '
fi
if [ -n "$five" ]; then
  q=$(printf '%.0f' "$five")
  printf '\033[34m5h \033[%sm%s%%\033[0m' "$(level_color "$q")" "$q"
  at=$(field '.rate_limits.five_hour.resets_at')
  if [ -n "$at" ]; then printf '\033[90m (%s)\033[0m' "$(date -r "$at" +%H:%M)"; fi
  printf '  '
fi
if [ -n "$seven" ]; then
  q=$(printf '%.0f' "$seven")
  printf '\033[34m7d \033[%sm%s%%\033[0m' "$(level_color "$q")" "$q"
  at=$(field '.rate_limits.seven_day.resets_at')
  if [ -n "$at" ]; then printf '\033[90m (%s)\033[0m' "$(date -r "$at" '+%a %H:%M')"; fi
fi
